sections.label: Cable cut incidents by contractors
sections.summary: Cable cut incidents rose from four each in 2013 and 2014 to seven in 2015, with three already in 2016, all 18 caused by third-party contractors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The number of incidents has grown steadily, from four each in 2013 and 2014 to seven in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In 2016 alone, there have already been three of such incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: All 18 cable cuts from 2013 to 2016 were caused by third-party contractors involved in the construction of new mass rapid transit (MRT) lines, such as the Downtown Line and the Thomson East-Coast Line, power cabling, water and sewage piping works and other development projects.

sections.label: Penalties for damaging telecommunication cables
sections.summary: Contractors who damage telecommunication cables during earthworks may be fined up to $1 million and imprisoned five years, with past penalties of $60,000 to $570,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Any contractor who fails to observe these precautions and damages any telecommunication cables while carrying out earthworks may be fined up to $1 million and imprisoned for five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IDA has previously prosecuted errant parties in Court, which has imposed penalties ranging from $60,000 to $570,000.

sections.label: IDA cable location and prosecution measures
sections.summary: IDA directed telcos to indicate GPS coordinates for new cables and manholes and install metallic tracer wires, and will investigate and prosecute cable cut offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To aid efforts in locating telecommunication cables going forward, IDA has directed all telcos to indicate GPS geographical coordinates for new deployments of telecommunication cables and manholes on their service plans; and to install metallic tracer wires along new underground optical fibre cables.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: At the same time, IDA will thoroughly investigate and prosecute those responsible for cable cuts, and will apply for deterrent sentences upon conviction.

sections.label: Varying outage estimates and affected consumers
sections.summary: The estimate varies, sometimes a couple of days or a couple of hours, and affected consumers vary depending on network configuration.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: On the first question as to the estimate, it varies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have sometimes as long as a couple of days, as well as a couple of hours, and the consumers affected can also vary, depending on the network configuration.
